entities.summary: Conxita Marsol i Riart, is an Andorran lawyer and politician, Minister of Presidency, Economy, Labour and Housing of Andorra since 2023. She was the Cònsol Major ("Mayor") of Andorra la Vella between 2015 and 2023.
